purpose: City-specific official registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry review.
assessment: Official city and national sources establish a local Kocaeli cadastral office, public city map and public TKGM parcel-search service. The city viewer did not load through the research reader, and no Kocaeli-specific safe vector schema or polygon response was verified. Known TKGM daily query throttling is not interpreted as absence.
registryAssessment: Kocaeli Büyükşehir Belediyesi’s official Şehir Rehberi service page describes online property/zoning lookups by block/parcel, address or map click. Its official announcement says the map provides cadastral information and that the city operates its own interactive digital map; official TKGM sources list the Kocaeli Cadastre Directorate and public Parsel Sorgu service. No feature-layer schema or Kocaeli polygon response was verified. The national coordinate API’s previously observed daily rate limit is a throttle and is not treated as no coverage; it was not retried for this city.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Kocaeli Metropolitan Municipality page says Şehir Rehberi supports online property/zoning queries by block/parcel number, address or map click.
Official city announcement describes map-click “Kadastro Bilgileri”, address and parcel lookup in its public interactive city guide.
Official viewer linked by the city service page; public web-reader request timed out, so no layer metadata or feature endpoint was obtained.
Official TKGM page lists the Kocaeli Cadastre Directorate in İzmit/Kocaeli and its local contact/address.
Official TKGM page documents the free public parcel query/map and safe parcel attributes, coordinate, sheet and KML/PDF functions; it states owner-name and Turkish ID searches are not available.
